title: Continuity of the orthogonal projection onto the range of an injective linear map
statement: Let n, ℓ ≥ 0. The map sending a continuous linear map L : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+ℓ} (ℝⁿ = Rn n, ℝ^{n+ℓ} = Amb n ℓ) to the orthogonal projection of ℝ^{n+ℓ} onto its range L(ℝⁿ) (Submodule.starProjection of LinearMap.range L) is continuous on the set of injective L, for the operator-norm topologies.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), ContinuousOn (fun L : Rn n →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ => (LinearMap.range L.toLinearMap).starProjection) {L : Rn n →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ | Function.Injective L}
